sources.title: The AI That Went Bananas: Unpacking Google's Viral 'Nano Banana' Image ...
sources.snippet: What is Nano Banana and Why Did It Go Viral? In early August 2025, the AI community was captivated by a mystery. An unnamed, highly capable image-editing model suddenly appeared on the LMArena testing platform. It wasn't listed in any official directory, but its results were terrifyingly good, effortlessly outperforming established models like DALL-E and Midjourney.

sources.title: Nvidia Open Sources Cascade RL, Powers 3B Model To Gold-Level AI ...
sources.snippet: Nvidia open sources its Cascade RL pipeline via NeMo-RL, enabling enterprises to achieve top-tier reasoning performance without building massive models from scratch. Nvidia has open-sourced the post-training pipeline behind its Nemotron-Cascade 2 model, signalling a shift in AI development where training methodology, rather than model size, defines performance. sources.title: Duck.ai - DuckDuckGo Help Pages
sources.snippet: Duck.ai is a feature that allows you to have private conversations with 3rd-party AI chat models, anonymized by us. Anthropic's Claude 4.5 Haiku, Mistral AI's Mistral Small 4, OpenAI's GPT-5.4 nano and GPT-5.4 mini, and gpt-oss-120b and Gemma 4 31B, hosted by Tinfoil.sh, are available to use for free in Duck.ai.
